_comment: sim-robust-esdf-boot-gate-v2 bounded GPU proof. Supersedes esdf-boot-gate-mission-fragment.json: v2 established (data/sim-robust-esdf-boot-gate-v2/report.md) that the STALE cc-bench1 baseline does NOT reproduce a never-acknowledged ESDF -- it incorporates ONE TICK LATE, and the gate's hold absorbs that one-tick boot race (esdfgate1: one ESDF_BOOT_GATE_HOLD at now=39, then completed at sim 174 with zero collision_dt trips). So PR #248's stale-baseline Run A proved the HOLD, not the fail-fast TRIP. This fragment keeps the HOST key 'esdf_boot_ack_grace_s' and adds a GENUINE never-incorporation reproduction for Run A via the opt-in env RESTOCK_ESDF_FORCE_NEVER_ACK (read by scripts/twin/restock_host/incorporation_ack.py). Merge 'esdf_boot_ack_grace_s' into the mission HOST config block (restock_manipulation/ros_host_config.json, read by scripts/twin/restock_manipulation/ros_host.py; config_preflight registers it HOST). The integration lane (twin-robot-in-store-boot-v1) holds the GPU and schedules both runs through /tmp/aile-gpu.lock, never forced, never touching the whispr service; do NOT edit the ~/datasets runtime configs from a worker PR -- this fragment is the hand-off.
_esdf_boot_ack_grace_s_note: SIM seconds (sensors.simulation_time, render-pacing-safe -- NOT wall). Measured from the first controller step of an operation. The gate HOLDs the op (streams NO arm motion, does not advance the phase) until the first valid incorporation ack (the mirrored station collision_time leaving the -1 not-ready sentinel for a real integration stamp >= 0); if the grace elapses with the stamp still stuck it FAILS FAST with 'nvblox ESDF incorporation never acknowledged within <N>s sim boot grace (collision_time stuck at -1.000 ...): likely nvblox not incorporating (masked-depth feed or mapper) or a stale/uncommissioned station baseline -- failing fast before the first arm motion instead of the mid-stage collision_dt invariant'. On the step the first valid ack arrives the controller logs ONE 'ESDF_BOOT_GATE_READY phase=... now=... collision_time=... (first valid nvblox incorporation ack ... source=sensors.collision_time packet mirror; collision_dt invariant now owns freshness)'. Once a valid ack has arrived the gate disarms permanently and the existing collision_dt freshness invariant is the sole owner (its band is untouched). Absent / <= 0 => gate OFF => byte-identical.

_run_A_trip_genuine_never_incorporation._env: RESTOCK_ESDF_FORCE_NEVER_ACK=1 (exported into the HOST stack env, alongside the existing ROS isolation). This is a PROOF/TEST switch (default off => byte-identical): the incorporation-ack node refuses every ESDF acknowledgement through the real reject path, so the arm host's collision_time stays at the -1 not-ready sentinel for the WHOLE run -- a faithful 'nvblox never incorporates', which the stale baseline is NOT. At host boot the console prints 'ESDF_FORCE_NEVER_ACK enabled: ...' so the switch is visible. The baseline (stale or fresh) is immaterial under this switch.
_run_A_trip_genuine_never_incorporation._pass_criteria: PASS = the console shows ESDF_BOOT_GATE_HOLD lines at phase=observe while collision_time stays -1.000, then 'ESDF_BOOT_GATE_TRIP phase=observe now=... nvblox ESDF incorporation never acknowledged within ~15.0s sim boot grace ...' fires BEFORE any arm motion (no approach/reach move streamed), and there is NO 'CONTROLLER_INVARIANT_TRIP ... collision_dt=40.0' and NO ESDF_BOOT_GATE_READY line. FAIL = the opaque collision_dt invariant trips first, or any arm motion streams before the gate fires, or the run proceeds (which would mean the switch did not take -- check the boot line).

_run_B_healthy_fresh_commission._setup: FRESH-commission the station (the meshuris0 setup), with esdf_boot_ack_grace_s=15.0 in the HOST config.
_run_B_healthy_fresh_commission._pass_criteria: PASS = UNCHANGED completion -- transfer + verify reach status succeeded; AT MOST one ESDF_BOOT_GATE_HOLD (the one-tick boot race), then EXACTLY ONE ESDF_BOOT_GATE_READY line, then the collision_dt invariant owns freshness with NO trip. This proves the key does not perturb a healthy run and that the READY transition is logged once. (A fresh commission typically incorporates during warm-up, so a HOLD may not appear at all; either way at most one.)

_activation_check: At host boot the HOST_EFFECTIVE_CONFIG console line reports 'esdf_boot_ack_grace_s': 15.0 (0.0 would mean the gate is off -- the run-277 wrong-config-file trap); config_preflight --require esdf_boot_ack_grace_s asserts it is present in the HOST config. For Run A, confirm the 'ESDF_FORCE_NEVER_ACK enabled' boot line is present.
_cpu_proof: scripts/twin/tests/test_sim_robust_esdf_boot_gate.py (16 tests): the stuck-stamp HOLD->named-fault; the one-tick-late hold-then-proceed with the collision_dt invariant SILENT; the once-per-op ESDF_BOOT_GATE_READY transition (and silence when off); any finite >=0 disarms + a transient -1 never re-arms; and the REAL IncorporationAckState under RESTOCK_ESDF_FORCE_NEVER_ACK leaving collision_time stuck at -1 (state=warming) driven through the real controller to the named TRIP. Run with PYTEST_DISABLE_PLUGIN_AUTOLOAD=1 PYTHONPATH=. python3 -m pytest scripts/twin/tests/test_sim_robust_esdf_boot_gate.py
